observations: Photo 0: a used automatic transaxle on a dirty yard floor, bell housing side up, with the torque converter fitted and its drive studs visible.
Photo 0: an extra housing with an output flange on the left side of the case, which may be a transfer unit for all wheel drive; an oil cooler and hoses are on the right.
Photo 1: the top and side of the same case with cooler hoses, brackets, wiring and an unplugged harness; a white paper label is stuck on the case but its text is not legible.
No maker's logo, transmission code, part number or VIN is readable in either photo.
Both photos carry a watermark 'NEMZ AUTOSPARE PARTS INV'.
Casing is dusty and oil stained; it is not shown running or fitted to a car.

identity.kind: used automatic gearbox (transaxle) with torque converter
read_from: photo 0 and photo 1 shape only: front wheel drive automatic transaxle with converter and cooler; the label in photo 1 is not legible

claims.evidence: Import origin cannot be shown by photos of the casing.
A sales opinion; no grade sheet or test result shown.
No Nissan or transmission maker's mark or code is readable; the label in photo 1 is too blurred to read. One unit is also claimed to fit two different vehicles, which depends on the exact code.

risks.risk: The gearbox is not the Rogue or Altima unit claimed, or is the wrong variant (2WD vs AWD, engine size, year range) for the buyer's car.
risks.proof: Sharp close-up of the white label in photo 1 and any code cast or stamped on the case, showing the transmission model and part number.
risks.if_unproven: Cannot be priced for a specific vehicle; identity stays unknown.

risks.risk: Internal failure, common in used CVT and automatic units: slipping, judder, whine, bad valve body or belt.
risks.proof: Clip of the gearbox running in a car, pulling away and changing speed, or a bench test record.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, for parts or rebuild.

risks.risk: Cracked case, broken mounts or damaged connector on the sides not shown.
risks.proof: Photos of every side of the case, the electrical connector and the mounting ears.

risks.risk: Torque converter or transfer unit not included in the sale or swapped from another unit.
risks.proof: Photo of the complete unit as handed over, with any serial on the converter.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the bare unit seen.

proof_requests: Sharp, close photo of the white label on the case and any stamped code or part number.
Clip of the gearbox running and shifting in a car.
Photos of every side of the case including the connector and mounts.
Statement of which car and year it came out of, with the donor VIN if available.
response.reason: The photos show a used automatic transaxle, but the only label is unreadable and no code identifies it, while a gearbox's price is set by the exact vehicle and transmission code. That code must be shown before even a worst case price is possible.
